package.description: An open source, multi-protocol, tabbed remote connections manager allowing you to view all of your connections in a simple yet powerful interface

en-US.description: An open source, multi-protocol, tabbed remote connections manager allowing you to view all of your connections in a simple yet powerful interface
en-US.longDescription: mRemoteNG is a fork of mRemote: an open source, tabbed, multi-protocol, remote connections manager for Windows. mRemoteNG adds bug fixes and new features to mRemote and allows you to view all of your remote connections in a simple yet powerful tabbed interface.
en-US.name: mRemoteNG

zh-CN.description: 一款开源、多协议、支持标签页的远程连接管理器，通过简洁而强大的界面让您轻松管理所有连接
zh-CN.longDescription: mRemoteNG 是 mRemote 的一个分支版本：这是一款面向 Windows 系统的开源、多标签页、支持多协议的远程连接管理工具。mRemoteNG 在 mRemote 基础上修复了错误并新增功能，通过简洁而强大的标签页界面，让您能够集中查看所有远程连接。
